personal.name: Rahul Mishra
personal.headline: Senior Software Engineer & Tech Lead — C++ | Java | Distributed Systems

summary: Senior Software Engineer and Tech Lead with 9+ years of experience building distributed, event-driven systems in C++ and Java for safety-critical aviation software. Strong grounding in Linux, concurrency, networking fundamentals and fault diagnosis, with a track record of owning features from design through production and leading small engineering teams.

bullets.text: Tech-led a 5-engineer squad through 3 on-schedule production releases on Boeing 777X/737 cabin systems, with zero post-go-live P1 defects over 18 months.

Architected a C++ microservices platform of 10 core services and 130+ REST APIs for aircraft cabin systems, built on a reusable multithreaded, event-driven framework that standardized lifecycle, messaging and routing.

Built C++ services for network device management (switch/device monitoring, SNMP/REST fault ingestion, performance metrics, topology mapping), fault management, and real-time ARINC 429 data streaming.
Implemented PKI-based security with mutual TLS across all services, including certificate lifecycle management and secure audit logging.
Designed 6 event-driven Java/Spring Boot microservices using Kafka and RabbitMQ, cutting API latency by 30%.
Delivered REST APIs and SDKs using Domain-Driven Design, expanding Boeing's partner ecosystem to 5+ global airlines for real-time telemetry streaming.
Engineered a real-time cargo detection and classification system (MQTT, OpenCV, GStreamer) that improved cargo processing efficiency by 70%.
Built an Angular cargo-tracking dashboard that cut on-call escalations by 30%, and an NGINX reverse proxy enforcing RBAC for external routing.
Introduced SonarQube quality gates in Jenkins CI/CD, cutting technical debt by 40%; adopted across 3+ business units.
Built AI-assisted SDLC tooling and an internal chatbot that reduced SME dependency and improved team productivity by 60%.
Administered Cisco LAN/WAN infrastructure across 3 enterprise sites supporting 200+ users, sustaining a 99.5% uptime SLA over 4 consecutive years with sub-4hr MTTR.
Developed Python and Bash automation scripts to parse device configuration logs, reducing per-device provisioning time by 35%.
Built a network documentation library (topology maps, runbooks, incident plays), saving an estimated 10+ engineer-hours per quarter.

education.degree: PG Diploma in Advanced Computing (Advanced Java & DSA)
